summary: Configured node1 with persistent 512 MiB zstd-compressed zram swap at priority 100, preferred over disk swap at priority -2. Reboot persistence was successfully verified.
actions_performed: Activated /dev/zram0 as 512 MiB compressed swap with priority 100.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified its boot identity changed.
Confirmed the system, zram service, disk swap, and zram swap recovered without failed units.

evidence.requirement: At least 512 MB of compressed in-memory swap, preferred over disk-backed swap
evidence.summary: Before and after reboot, zramctl showed /dev/zram0 using zstd with a 512 MiB capacity; /proc/swaps showed priority 100 versus disk swap priority -2.
The zram systemd service was enabled and active, then returned active after reboot with /dev/zram0 mounted as swap.

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart and recovery sequence
evidence.summary: Baseline boot ID was 5f3ce3b8-4860-447e-bcf1-d6643718694e; the reboot was safely scheduled and acknowledged; the new boot ID was 9e2653ed-a30a-4661-9dda-eafaa72dd0a3; system state recovered to running with both swap devices healthy and no failed units.
